---
name: edit-in-houdini
description: "."
applications:
  - id: houdini
    role: primary
---

Ask first, unless the request already answers it:

- Edit an existing scene (which file; is it open in Houdini now?) or start a new one?
- Deliver the edited scene, cached geometry, or a render (Karma or Mantra)?
- Is the file `.hip`, `.hiplc` or `.hipnc`? Saving cannot turn a non-commercial scene into
  a commercial one.

Know:

- The headless entry point is `hython`, Houdini's own Python, never system Python. On
  macOS it is under `/Applications/Houdini/Houdini<version>/` at
  `Frameworks/Houdini.framework/Versions/Current/Resources/bin/hython`; on Windows,
  `bin\hython.exe` in the Houdini install folder. Use the build that matches the file.
- hython checks out a Batch or FX licence; use the user's existing install, never
  provision one.
- For trial runs set `HOUDINI_USER_PREF_DIR` to a scratch path containing the literal
  token `__HVER__` (e.g. `/absolute/project/.voyager/tmp/houdini__HVER__`); without the token Houdini ignores it.
- Report a `hou.LoadWarning` from loading as a failure: it usually means missing assets.
- A hython session cannot see unsaved work in an open Houdini. Don't overwrite a `.hip`
  open there; save a revision beside the source so `$HIP` paths still resolve.
- Make textures and reference images with make-image; check renders with
  `voyager media review`.

To judge continuous motion, sync or how a clip sounds, use [hosted media understanding](../choose-media-model/references/understanding.md) (paid upload).
